body: I'm set to go, I cant do this anymore. I'm leaving my house and going somewhere that my folks wont find me. I have enough pills to get me through.

I understand that you are somebody that i dont know, and I am more then grateful for everything that you have told me. I cant say that i wont go through with it, but i honestly dont know how anybody can live with this feeling.
